canonicalFacts.claim: Antithyroid drugs are widely used in hyperthyroidism therapy with variations in dose, regimen and duration
Glucocorticoids prevent Graves' ophthalmopathy progression following radioiodine treatment
Multiple treatment modalities are effective for active, moderate-to-severe Graves' orbitopathy including teprotumumab, mycophenolate plus IV glucocorticoids, and rituximab
Lithium carbonate as add-on therapy to radioiodine increases cure rates and decreases T4 levels compared to radioiodine alone
Subclinical hyperthyroidism is associated with increased risk of atrial fibrillation, heart failure, cardiovascular mortality and all-cause mortality

lifestyleRecommendations.recommendation: Smoking cessation is important in Graves' orbitopathy to avoid prolonged disease

redFlags: Risk of thyroid storm in hyperthyroid patients undergoing surgery
Subclinical hyperthyroidism increases cardiovascular and fracture risks
Weight gain commonly occurs following hyperthyroidism treatment
